title: test({angular-query-experimental,angular-query-persist-client}): align mock names with react-query and the options they are passed to
body:
## 🎯 Changes

Renames `vi.fn`/`vi.spyOn` mocks in `angular-query-experimental` and `angular-query-persist-client` tests so they follow the names used in `react-query`'s tests, or the option they are passed to when `react-query` has no equivalent:

| Before | After | Files |
|---|---|---|
| `fetchFn`, `spy` (passed as `queryFn`) | `queryFn` | `inject-query` |
| `boundaryFn` (passed as `throwOnError`) | `throwOnError` | `inject-query`, `inject-mutation` |
| `perCallOnSuccess`, `onSuccessPerCall`, `onSettledOnFunction` (callbacks passed to `mutate()`) | `onSuccessMutate`, `onSettledMutate` | `inject-mutation` |
| `onErrorMock` (`console.error` spy) | `consoleMock` | `with-persist-query-client` |

Where the new name matches the option key, the property uses shorthand (`queryFn: fetchFn,` → `queryFn,`).

Renames only; no test behavior changes.
